findings.what_happened: In the first hop evaluation, the model relied on internal knowledge to state that Northumberland is in the northeast of England, even though none of the Hop 1 passages contained this geographic detail, violating the explicit instruction not to rely on internal knowledge to fill in missing factual gaps. It also failed to explicitly format the required outputs listing 'Retrieved required evidence documents' and 'Missing required evidence documents'.
findings.quote: Passage [3] states Lindisfarne Castle is located on Holy Island, near Berwick-upon-Tweed, Northumberland, England.  Northumberland is in the northeast of England, not the southeast.
